Question 2
?

Find a unit normal vector to the level curve of the function f(x,y)=x+yx−y that passes through the point where (x,y)=(−2,−1).

a
 55(i−2j)
b
 510(4i+2j)
c
55(2j−j)
d
 22(i−j)
e
 510(2i+4j)
